question: In the Columns sheet I hid a bunch of columns. How do I bring back just one of them?
reference_answer: Press gv to unhide all columns, or open the Columns sheet (Shift+C), move to the width cell of that column (0 when hidden) and set it to a positive number.

question: How can I search and replace text inside every cell of one column?
reference_answer: Use * with a regex/substitution to make a new column, or g* to replace in place in the current column.

question: I have an int column with empty-looking null values. How do I select all the rows where it is null?
reference_answer: Null cells hold None. Use the nulls column of the Describe sheet (Shift+I) and zs to select the null rows, or z| with a Python expression.

question: Can I save the whole session, including column types I changed, and open it again later?
reference_answer: Save all sheets with g Ctrl+S using the .vds extension; the VisiData-specific format keeps column types.

question: One float column needs scientific notation while the others show four decimals. Can I set a format for just that column?
reference_answer: Change the fmtstr of that column on the Columns sheet.

question: Is there a way to show more decimal places for one column only, without changing the global float format?
reference_answer: Adjust the precision of the single column (see the docs on quickly adjusting the precision of a float).

question: How do I colour a cell green whenever its value equals a certain word, on every sheet?
reference_answer: Add a colorizer that tests the cell value, as described in the conditional formatting section.

question: I marked a file for deletion in a directory listing. What finalizes the delete?
reference_answer: Delete marks the file; committing the sheet (z Ctrl+S, commit-sheet) applies it.

question: How do I switch to a different colour theme?
reference_answer: Set a theme as described in the Setting the Theme section.

question: I have a lookup table in one file and a data file with the keys. How do I pull the matching values into the data sheet?
reference_answer: Join the two sheets on the shared key column; the extend join type keeps the original sheet and adds the columns.
